create_uniform_distribution: create a Uniform distribution object to sample random floats between a low and high bound
create_normal_distribution: create a Normal distribution object to sample random values from a Gaussian with given loc and scale
create_biased_random_walk: create a BiasedRandomWalk object to generate Ornstein-Uhlenbeck process noise with configurable stdev and timescale
create_uniform_choice_distribution: create a UniformChoice distribution object to randomly sample from a list of discrete choices
create_uniform_point_on_sphere: create a UniformPointOnSphere object to sample a random 3D unit vector on the surface of a sphere
